editor.title: Create in the Editor
editor.body: Build a small Jump with structured controls and see it appear in Preview.

tracker.title: Travel in the Tracker
tracker.body: Add a Jump, make choices, arrange the chain, and explore persistent benefits.

beginner.title: Beginner friendly
beginner.body: Keep advanced panels tucked away, show more explanations, and simplify dense actions.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.body: Keep every workspace control visible and use the full-density interface.

welcome.title: Welcome to Jumpchain Visualizer
welcome.body: This guided tour first explains Home, then lets you practice in either the Editor or Chain Tracker.
welcome.detail: The lesson uses temporary data. It is saved only so you can resume the tour, and it is permanently removed when you finish or exit.

home-navigation.title: Your work is always close
home-navigation.body: The top bar is global navigation: select the JV brand for Home, Editor or Chain Tracker for a workspace hub, and Settings for preferences.
home-navigation.detail: Back and Forward follow in-app location history. During this lesson these controls stay locked so temporary work cannot leak into normal navigation.

home-workspaces.title: Start new work or resume
home-workspaces.body: The two large Home cards open the Editor and Chain Tracker hubs. Existing projects and chains appear in the recent lists below them.
home-workspaces.detail: Creating a Jump means authoring a package; starting a chain means importing Jumps and recording a Jumper’s decisions.

choose-branch.title: Where would you like to begin?
choose-branch.body: Choose a card below to navigate into a temporary Editor or Tracker workspace.
choose-branch.detail: The app will visibly switch workspaces. At the end you can take the other branch or finish.

editor-overview.title: You’re in the practice Editor
editor-overview.body: Your branch choice opened My First Jump. Content is on the left, the selected declaration is edited in the center, and live Preview is on the right.
editor-overview.detail: Nothing here appears in Your Jump projects. Continue to begin navigating the project yourself.

editor-open-details.title: Navigate to Jump details
editor-open-details.body: In the left Content explorer, select Jump details.
editor-open-details.detail: Explorer selections decide what the center Structured pane edits. The highlighted row is the package-level starting point.

editor-metadata.title: Review the Jump’s identity
editor-metadata.body: Structured now shows the name, description, authors, version, and expandable Jump settings for point configuration.
editor-metadata.detail: These values are prefilled so this lesson can focus on the authoring loop. Continue after you locate them.

editor-add-choice.title: Add your first Choice
editor-add-choice.body: Select Add in the project toolbar, then select Choice from the menu that opens.
editor-add-choice.detail: The Editor creates a reusable top-level Choice in choices.jdef and navigates directly to its Structured form.

editor-configure-choice.title: Give the Choice a clear identity
editor-configure-choice.body: Change Handle from new_choice to road_companion and Name from New Choice to Road Companion.
editor-configure-choice.detail: Handles use lowercase letters, numbers, and single underscores. Leave Selection type as Toggle; the step completes after both identity fields are valid.

editor-open-section.title: Navigate to the section
editor-open-section.body: In the left Content explorer, expand Sections if needed and select first_steps.
editor-open-section.detail: Sections control reading order. This selection replaces the Choice form with the section’s Structured content editor.

editor-place-choice.title: Place the Choice in a section
editor-place-choice.body: Under Content & effects, select + Direct choice. In the new placement, set Choice to display to road_companion.
editor-place-choice.detail: The top-level Choice defines behavior; this placement decides where readers see it. Keep the generated placement handle.

editor-preview.title: Check the reader's view
editor-preview.body: Look at live Preview on the right and find Road Companion inside First steps.
editor-preview.detail: The Diagnostics bar along the bottom reports authoring problems. A viable Jump has no blocking red diagnostics.

editor-advanced-offer.title: Your minimum Jump is ready
editor-advanced-offer.body: You completed the minimum loop: add a declaration, configure it, place it, and verify it.
editor-advanced-offer.detail: Explore advanced tools for a short navigation lesson covering files, source, appearance, and export, or finish this branch.

editor-advanced-toggle.title: Reveal advanced views
editor-advanced-toggle.body: Select Advanced views in the project toolbar.
editor-advanced-toggle.detail: This reveals Files navigation and Source and Properties editing tabs without changing your authored data.

editor-advanced-tabs.title: Navigate to Files and Source
editor-advanced-tabs.body: Select Files in the left navigation.
editor-advanced-tabs.detail: The center pane switches to Source for the selected .jdef file. Content and Structured remain the safer visual path.

editor-advanced-appearance.title: Return to visual appearance
editor-advanced-appearance.body: Select Content, then select Jump appearance in the explorer.
editor-advanced-appearance.detail: This returns to Structured editing. Appearance, layouts, themes, and Preview inspection tools control presentation separately from content.

editor-advanced-export.title: Export only when it is ready
editor-advanced-export.body: The Export .jmp action packages a finished project for use in the Tracker.
editor-advanced-export.detail: Export validates definitions, references, files, and assets first. The tour does not create an archive; continue after locating the action.

editor-summary.title: You built a working Jump
editor-summary.body: You navigated the explorer and completed the core Editor loop: add, configure, place, and verify.
editor-summary.detail: Continue into the Tracker lesson, or finish now. This temporary project is deleted after your interface choice.

tracker-overview.title: You’re in the practice Tracker
tracker-overview.body: Your branch choice opened an isolated chain. The left rail holds Earth and ordered Jumps; the main view shows the selected entry; top tabs collect lasting results.
tracker-overview.detail: Nothing here appears in saved chains. Continue to navigate the Tracker yourself.

tracker-library.title: Open the Jump Library
tracker-library.body: Select Library at the top of the left rail.
tracker-library.detail: Library replaces the timeline with installed Jumps available to add. The current timeline is preserved.

tracker-add-jump.title: Add The Crossroads
tracker-add-jump.body: On The Crossroads library card, select Add to chain.
tracker-add-jump.detail: The Tracker returns to the timeline, appends the Jump, selects it, and displays its choices in the main view.
tracker-add-jump.completedTitle: The Crossroads is now in your chain
tracker-add-jump.completedBody: The Tracker returned to Chain, added The Crossroads after The Trailhead, and selected it for you.
tracker-add-jump.completedDetail: The highlighted timeline entry holds this Jump’s place in your history. Its choices are now visible in the main view.

tracker-route-choice.title: Make a defining choice
tracker-route-choice.body: Under Choose a route, select either Forest road or Coastal road.
tracker-route-choice.detail: This is select-one: choosing one option replaces the other. The result is stored with this exact Jump entry.

tracker-perk-choice.title: Take lasting training
tracker-perk-choice.detail: This toggle Choice spends its cost and grants a perk. The Tracker will project that perk into Inventory.

tracker-item-choice.title: Take something with you
tracker-item-choice.detail: This toggle Choice spends its cost and grants an item that the Tracker projects into Inventory.

tracker-reorder.title: Arrange the journey
tracker-reorder.body: In the left timeline, move The Crossroads before The Trailhead with drag-and-drop or its Move earlier action.
tracker-reorder.detail: Earth stays fixed at the beginning. Reordering changes chronology while keeping decisions attached to their Jump.

tracker-inventory.title: See what persists
tracker-inventory.body: Select Inventory in the top page navigation.
tracker-inventory.detail: This navigation replaces the Jump view with the chain’s persistent perks and items. Continue after the tab activates.

tracker-inventory-result.title: Your perk and item are persistent
tracker-inventory-result.body: Inventory now contains Field Training and Traveler’s Pack from your earlier choices.
tracker-inventory-result.detail: Each record shows its kind and source Jump. The historical cutoff can also answer when a benefit entered the chain.

tracker-supplements.title: Open Supplements
tracker-supplements.body: Select Supplements in the top page navigation.
tracker-supplements.detail: This page manages optional systems. Supplements begin disabled and can add their own pages.

tracker-enable-body-mod.title: Enable Classic Body Mod
tracker-enable-body-mod.body: In the Classic Body Mod card, turn on Enabled.
tracker-enable-body-mod.detail: Enabling adds a Classic Body Mod page, but does not navigate away from Manage Supplements.

tracker-open-body-mod.title: Navigate into Body Mod
tracker-open-body-mod.body: In the Classic Body Mod card, select Open page.
tracker-open-body-mod.detail: The dedicated supplement page replaces the management list. You can return with Manage Supplements.
tracker-open-body-mod.completedBody: The management list has been replaced by Classic Body Mod’s dedicated workspace.
tracker-open-body-mod.completedDetail: The highlighted page contains its budget, build, body type, stats, perks, and review controls.

tracker-use-body-mod.title: Shape a persistent baseline
tracker-use-body-mod.body: In Build & body, choose a build or body type different from the current selection.
tracker-use-body-mod.detail: Body Mod describes the Jumper’s persistent baseline, so this configuration follows the chain.

tracker-summary.title: Your practice chain is underway
tracker-summary.body: You navigated Library, the timeline, Inventory, Supplements, and Body Mod while recording a complete set of practice decisions.
tracker-summary.detail: Continue into the Editor lesson, or finish now. This temporary chain is deleted after your interface choice.

mode-choice.title: Choose your interface
mode-choice.body: Choose the presentation preset you want to use after the tour.
mode-choice.detail: Beginner friendly adds guidance; Advanced exposes the full interface. A restarted tour can keep its already configured settings.
